name: 钉钉 AI 助理
desc: AI assistant built into DingTalk, reading DingTalk's own data
desc_zh: 长在钉钉里、能读钉钉数据的 AI 助理
solves: It only sees what DingTalk holds — chats, approvals, docs, tables. In exchange, nothing has to be exported to a tool that cannot reach them anyway.
solves_zh: 它只看得见钉钉里的东西——消息、审批、文档、表格。换来的是不必再把数据导给一个根本够不着它的工具。
best_for: A team whose approvals and chats already live in DingTalk and will not move.
best_for_zh: 审批和沟通都已经在钉钉里、不会搬到别处的团队。
notes: 集成在 钉钉 内的能力。来源：https://open.dingtalk.com/document/assistants-overview
